title: Lyria 3
description: Google Lyria 3 — high-fidelity music from a text prompt, with optional lyrics and up to 10 reference images to condition the mood. MP3 output (SynthID-watermarked).

images.description: Optional reference images (up to 10) to condition the track's mood/theme. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads.

prompt.description: Description of the music to generate (10-2000 characters).
